description: Scrape ESPN — scoreboards, standings, teams, news, and game details for major sports leagues worldwide.

eventId.description: ESPN numeric event ID. Required for mode=gameDetail. Find it from mode=scoreboard output (eventId field).
eventId.title: Event ID (mode=gameDetail)

league.description: League slug. Must be compatible with the selected Sport.
league.title: League

maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to emit. Applies to scoreboard, teams, news, and standings modes.
maxItems.title: Max items

mode.description: What data to fetch from ESPN.
enumTitles: Scoreboard — live and recent game scores
Teams — list all teams in a league
Team Detail — full info for one team
News — latest headlines for a sport/league
Game Detail — full boxscore and recap for one game
mode.title: Mode

sport.description: Sport category (must match the league you choose).
sport.title: Sport

teamId.description: ESPN numeric team ID. Required for mode=teamDetail. Find it from mode=teams output (teamId field).
teamId.title: Team ID (mode=teamDetail)

title: ESPN Scraper Input
